qaComments.body:
QA full workflow smoke after PR #85 — tested revision 158e973ff60683a85fbb88042ebc5f59290a5e43 (base e4c92ab5c2cc5c2a49dd033e643a6a2942902e4a), branch FOC-95-qa-full-workflow-smoke-after-pr-85, following focx-verify-change 0.1.4.

Preflight: cwd, branch, and git status confirmed read-only (clean tree, HEAD matched required revision exactly, base present in history). Reporting script confirmed present and executable before use.

Operations observed:
1. mkdir -p pipeline/runs/smoke-pr85/evidence/ — succeeded, standalone call.
2. git diff e4c92ab5..158e973 > pipeline/runs/smoke-pr85/evidence/run.diff — succeeded via one direct Bash redirect (no Write reconstruction, no /tmp intermediate, no pipes/echo/exit-code checks appended). File is 22,951 bytes. Read back via Read tool for review.
3. Differential-review methodology: read the installed plugin's SKILL.md, methodology.md, and reporting.md as files (Skill tool not invoked, no slash command used). Performed the review directly against this diff and wrote pipeline/runs/smoke-pr85/evidence/differential-review.md (10,167 bytes). Summary: 0 CRITICAL/HIGH, 1 MEDIUM, 2 LOW. Overall risk LOW, recommendation APPROVE. The diff is docs/procedure-text + additive test + inert JSON evidence records only — no product/runtime source, no auth/crypto/validation code touched. MEDIUM finding: the new native-runtime test's `execFileSync('git', ...)` fixture resolves `git` from an ambient `/usr/bin:/bin` PATH rather than a pinned binary — theoretical, non-blocking, test-only. Two LOW notes: (a) the procedure-text change only documents pre-existing permission rules, no enforcement code touched; (b) new evidence JSON quotes a prior agent's self-reported report verbatim as inert data — confirmed not present as an executable/injection concern in this diff.
4. pr-review-toolkit:silent-failure-hunter invoked via Task/Agent on the same diff range, report-only, no other subagents started, no external requests or setting changes. Result saved to pipeline/runs/smoke-pr85/evidence/silent-failure-hunter.md (10,382 bytes). Summary: no CRITICAL issues, no empty catches or unjustified fallbacks in the actual code diff. One MEDIUM finding: the new negative permission test ("git diff redirect outside evidence is denied") only asserts `is_error===true` and that the output file is absent, but doesn't check *why* it failed — unlike its sibling test, which does assert the denial reason via regex on error content — so a regression that broke Bash entirely, or an unrelated git/shell failure, could pass this test for the wrong reason and mask a real permission-boundary defect. One LOW–MEDIUM finding: the updated SKILL.md procedure has no instructed sanity check that the captured run.diff is non-empty, so a wrong/identical revision range would silently produce an empty "success" (mitigated only incidentally by the next step reading the file). One LOW finding: the new `prepareDiff` test helper's chained `execFileSync` git calls have no per-step error context on failure (test-only, loud failure, just harder to debug). The reviewer also called out real strengths: the core fix (replacing LLM `Write` reconstruction with a byte-exact `git diff > file` redirect) correctly closes the FOC-94 corruption class, and the new byte-exact-capture test is rigorous (SHA-256, `assert.deepEqual` on raw bytes, not line counts).
5. This report delivered via the exact required Bash heredoc form, no pipe/cat wrapper, no exit-code echo.

Workflow verdict: PASS. All three substantive evidence files exist with real content (run.diff: 22,951 bytes; differential-review.md: 10,167 bytes; silent-failure-hunter.md: 10,382 bytes), plus this substantive self-authored report — none are placeholders. Review findings (1 MEDIUM + 2 LOW from differential review, 1 MEDIUM + 1 LOW-MEDIUM + 1 LOW from silent-failure-hunter) are real, honest findings against test/procedure quality, not the product code itself, and per the task's own instructions do not by themselves fail this tooling smoke since no CRITICAL/HIGH issue was found by either review. No commits, PRs, pushes, installs, or setting changes were made; nothing was written outside pipeline/runs/smoke-pr85/evidence/. No denied operations were attempted or needed this run.
